# Playtype Playground

Playtype Playground is a Shiny for Python dashboard for NBA playtype statistics.

## Primary content

- /: Player filters, scatter plot, player details, comparisons, season history, and PPP rankings.
- /privacy.html: Privacy information.
- /terms.html: Terms of use.

## Data note

The dashboard reads a local CSV of regular-season NBA playtype results collected through nba_api. Run playtype_playground/fetch_nba_data.py to refresh it.

## Crawler policy

Public pages may be indexed and used for retrieval. See /robots.txt for crawler directives.
